messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction: hives, difficult breathing, swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Also seek emergency medical attention if you have symptoms of a spinal blood clot: back pain, numbness, tingling, muscle weakness in your lower body, or loss of bladder or bowel control.
Apixaban can cause you to bleed more easily. Call your doctor at once if you have signs of bleeding such as:
- bruising or bleeding that will not stop, unusual bleeding (nosebleeds, bleeding gums, vaginal bleeding);
- unexpected pain, joint pain or swelling;
- headache, dizziness, weakness, feeling like you might pass out;
- urine that looks red, pink, or brown; or
- bloody or tarry stools, coughing up blood or vomit that looks like coffee grounds.
Common side effects of apixaban may include:
- bleeding, including heavy menstrual bleeding; or
- headache, vomiting.
This is not a complete list of side effects and others may occur. Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects. You may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["Apixaban", "has symptom of spinal blood clot", "muscle weakness in lower body"]

The relation 'has symptom of spinal blood clot' in the triplet is defined as 'The specified symptom may indicate the presence of a spinal blood clot as a potential adverse effect of the subject drug.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'mimics symptoms of': The subject condition or drug may present symptoms that resemble those of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has withdrawal symptom': When the subject drug is stopped abruptly, the patient may experience the symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
